segments.title: Pepito Cold Open & Station Sign-On
segments.notes: Pepito delivers the official top-of-hour broadcast sign-on and countdown, identifies as the dog who produces the show.

segments.title: April Fools Opening & News Desk
segments.notes: Case Blackwell opens the broadcast acknowledging April Fools Day, decides against planned bits, discusses Super Mario movie plans with chat, mentions Kendall at work.

segments.title: Artemis 2 Moon Launch Coverage
segments.notes: Chet commandeers the broadcast after 'science' trigger; covers NASA's Artemis 2 crewed launch from Cape Canaveral, shows live NASA feed, discusses mission details and reusable engines.

segments.title: Hype Train April Fools Prank
segments.notes: Hype Train appears claiming to be a normal human guy as an April Fools prank, delivers freestyle rap about flesh lights and jelqing rods, reveals he's still a train at the end.

segments.title: News Headlines Rundown
segments.notes: Case runs through headlines: Iran/Trump tensions, Marco Rubio 'paper tiger' clip, RFK Jr pushing peptide treatments, Lindsay Buckingham stalking attack, AI in Hollywood, tobacco plants engineered for psychedelics, San Gabriel Valley eye-biting flies, squirrels vaping, transvestigation of Erika Kirk and Sydney Sweeney, DTF St. Louis/Peyronie's disease, Trump White House ballroom construction halted.

segments.title: Town Hall with Jevrything & Everything Bagel
segments.notes: Town Hall segment with musician Jevrything and a sentient Everything Bagel; audience questions cover cream cheese vs butter, identity philosophy, gluten-free contradictions, Superman killing methods, pizza on bagels, love, GTA 6, and Inspector Gadget references.

segments.title: Jo Rogen Experience & Munch & Crum Debate
segments.notes: Joe Rogan segment glitches (floating Snapchat ghost); transitions to Munch & Crum debate on 'Should Joe Exist?' with Crum arguing for erasure from source code, Munch defending existence; chat poll fails.

segments.title: Post-Show Wrap & Kristi Noem Husband Scandal
segments.notes: Case wraps up, takes call from Kendall (forgot purse for movie), investigates Byron Noem 'bimbo vacation' cross-dressing photos leaked by webcam model Lydia Love, critiques bimbo authenticity, raids to Bruce Green, signs off for Friday stream.

lore_notes.fact: Uses $30 Amazon wireless in-ear monitors (Elgato transmitters) for broadcast audio.
Had salt replacement therapy in bone marrow — bones are now ~30% road salt for clear skin.
23andMe ancestry test returned 100% bleach (absence of race).
Used to have a very deep voice; had vocal cord procedure to raise pitch.
Husband of DHS Secretary Kristi Noem; leaked photos show cross-dressing 'bimbo vacation' with fake breasts and hot pants, recognized by webcam model Lydia Love.

episode_summary: Case Blackwell hosts an April Fools edition of Barely Informed News, covering the Artemis 2 crewed moon launch before a chaotic Hype Train segment where the train poses as a normal human. A Town Hall with musician Jevrything and a sentient Everything Bagel descends into philosophical absurdity, followed by a glitched Jo Rogen Experience that segues into a Munch & Crum debate on whether Joe Rogan should exist. The broadcast closes with Case breaking the Byron Noem 'bimbo vacation' cross-dressing scandal live on air before departing for the Super Mario Bros. Movie.
